show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/a7rE6s
show.description: A seemingly lowly tarot card reader, underestimated and divorced by his ambitious wife, reveals his hidden influence as the "Ultimate Protector" when he remarries a powerful pharmaceutical heiress and uses his secret connections to dominate the business world.
